items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Master Collette was like my fairy man. I mean, he took me across to the other shore... Master Collette would call me and send me on gigs

ctx.x: Oh cat! And then Cannonball would call me cause Quincy told him to call, and guys would call and - I’m telling you about... So Master Collette would call me and send me on gigs, cause he’d have big studio gigs, you know.
